description: List the Thalovant runtime groups visible to the authenticated account. Requires the hubs:read scope. The response is not paginated — every visible group is returned at once.

apiUrl.description: Control-plane base URL. Configured credentials may only be used on their configured origin; defaults to https://api.thalovant.com.

loginScope.description: Optional login scope used with THALOVANT_EMAIL and THALOVANT_PASSWORD.

ownerId.description: Admin tokens only. Unlike the marketplace catalog, which silently ignores this for non-admins, passing another account's id here fails 403 "Ownership required". Omit it to list your own groups.

name: thalovant_list_runtime_groups
title: List Runtime Groups
